about: Dennis's written notes on lab and factory boards (dennis-plays.json, field note), sorted by Claude into the kinds of judgement he makes, 2026-10-31. A label is only set where the note says it; 'fun' means 4-5 stars with a positive note. Use for checking a critic: its flag for a kind should fire on the boards listed under that kind and stay quiet on the 'fun' boards. 2026-11-01: lab batch 11 (the 175-200 candidate's clock warnings): 176, 189, 193 (Gemini's critic: clock too loose) Dennis agreed, 'too loose and it adds nothing'; 198 (critic: clock too tight) Dennis 'seems fine. Flag for tight needs work', so it gets no label.

kinds.lateSqueeze: the hard part is at the very end (tray pressure while finishing) - frustrating
kinds.boringAfterClock: once the clock is taken it is just collecting - no tension left
kinds.clockTooTight: no route to the clock a person can find in time - wants more spare moves
kinds.clockTooLoose: the clock has more spare than it needs - too easy
kinds.guessing: progress depends on blind digging or guessing, not on working things out
kinds.specialAddsNothing: an ice, lock or clock that does not change how you play
